Kuwait Overtime Calculator

Enter your salary and your overtime hours by day, at night, on the rest day and on holidays to see what the law says you are owed.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Work out your overtime pay

Basic plus regular payments (Article 55).

Overtime rules in Kuwait

ItemRule
Normal hours8 a day and 48 a week (Article 64)
Ramadan36 hours a week, not limited to Muslims
Overtime conditionsA written order and a genuine need; capped at 2 hours a day, 3 days a week, 90 days and 180 hours a year (Article 66)
OvertimeNormal pay + 25%; the law has no night premium
Rest dayPay + 50% plus a substitute rest day (Article 67)
Public holidays (13 days)Double pay plus a substitute day (Article 68)
Hourly wageTotal wage ÷ 26 ÷ 8 in common practice

Example: Total wage KWD 6,000, so the hourly wage is 6,000 ÷ 26 ÷ 8 = KWD 28.846. Ten overtime hours: 10 × 28.846 × 1.25 = 360.577; four rest-day hours: 4 × 28.846 × 1.5 = 173.077. Total KWD 533.654 plus a substitute rest day.

The 26-day divisor comes from practice and Article 67, which works out the daily wage from actual working days; some employers divide by 30, so pick the alternative to see the difference.

Frequently asked questions

How is overtime calculated in Kuwait?

At the normal hourly wage plus 25% (Article 66); in practice the hourly wage is the monthly wage ÷ 26 ÷ 8. The law sets no night premium.

What is the overtime limit in Kuwait?

2 hours a day, 3 days a week, and 90 days and 180 hours a year, on the employer's written order.

How much is rest-day work paid in Kuwait?

Normal pay plus at least 50%, together with a substitute rest day (Article 67).

How much is public-holiday work paid in Kuwait?

Double pay plus a substitute rest day, for any of the 13 public holidays (Article 68).

Do managers get overtime in Kuwait?

Yes. The law does not exclude managers from the overtime rules; it excludes domestic workers and those covered by special laws.

Sources

  • Kuwait Labour Law 6/2010 — Articles 64 to 68 (Al-Anba, February 2010, Arabic)
  • NATLEX — Kuwait Private Sector Labour Law 6/2010
  • Arab Times — how overtime is calculated in Kuwait (January 2016)
